name: Supplemental Insurance Inbound Calls

hero.headline: Supplemental Insurance Inbound Calls
hero.subheadline: Connect with high-intent consumers actively looking for supplemental insurance solutions.

overview: Supplemental Insurance Inbound Calls are consumers who see an offer and dial in themselves, generated by Altarious Global performance campaigns and delivered to your business in real time. Reach consumers seeking dental, vision, accident, critical illness and hospital indemnity coverage to fill gaps in their primary plan.

Supplemental insurance is often a spontaneous, need-driven purchase: a consumer learns that a crown is not covered or receives a hospital bill and wants protection before it happens again. Inbound Call programs capture that urgency by presenting dental, vision, accident and critical illness offers to consumers searching for them and inviting a direct call to a licensed agent. Callers already know which gap they want to fill, so agents can present the appropriate product and complete enrollment efficiently, then review whether other supplemental or core coverages make sense for the household.

This product is suited to insurance businesses with a team ready to answer during defined hours, a clear view of the consumer they want, and the capacity to convert a live conversation. The acquisition objective is simple: put your team in front of supplemental insurance consumers at the moment they are deciding.
targetConsumer: Adults aged 25 to 75 who have a primary health plan with meaningful out-of-pocket exposure, or who lack dental and vision coverage entirely. Key segments include self-employed workers and gig earners, families enrolled in high-deductible plans, Medicare beneficiaries who want dental and vision, and hourly workers whose employers offer limited benefits.
consumerIntent: Typical intent signals include: searching for dental insurance, vision insurance or accident insurance plans; facing an upcoming dental procedure or needing new glasses without coverage; enrolled in a high-deductible health plan and concerned about out-of-pocket costs; recently enrolled in medicare and looking to add dental and vision benefits.
howGenerated: Calls are generated through call-only and click-to-call performance campaigns targeting searches such as "dental insurance plans" and "vision insurance", alongside social and comparison placements. Every source is tracked, so call quality can be traced back to the campaign that produced it.
qualification: Qualification is configured to your appetite. Standard supplemental insurance criteria include: age 18 or older and a resident of a state where the agent is licensed; type of supplemental coverage sought identified, such as dental, vision, accident, critical illness or hospital indemnity; current primary health or medicare coverage status confirmed; not seeking supplemental products as a replacement for major medical coverage; approximate budget and number of people to be covered discussed; interested in enrolling or receiving a quote today.
delivery: Calls are routed to your sales line in real time by state or ZIP, schedule and agent availability, with concurrency limits and daily caps set to your capacity. Call tracking and recording are available for quality control.

process.title: PPC / Traffic Acquisition

faq.q: Can programs focus on a single product such as dental only?
faq.a: Yes. Campaigns and screening can be built around dental, vision, accident, critical illness or hospital indemnity individually, or around a bundled ancillary offering.

faq.q: Do these programs work alongside Medicare or health campaigns?
faq.a: Supplemental programs pair well with health and Medicare acquisition, and transfers can be routed to the same agents to support cross-selling and multi-policy households.

faq.q: How do you handle consumers who actually need major medical coverage?
faq.a: Screening confirms primary coverage status, and consumers who need comprehensive health insurance are routed separately or excluded, depending on your product line.
